tiers.name: Capability and routing
tiers.goal: Use Fable 5 for orchestration and route bounded work, verification, fallback, and human escalation deliberately.
requiredPractices: Fable 5 orchestrates multi-stage work instead of doing all worker tasks directly.
Worker agents or deterministic tools handle bounded high-volume work.
Independent verifier grades artifacts with clean context.
Safety-boundary and protected 27vette-boundary cases escalate or use approved fallback.

tiers.name: Orchestration primitives
tiers.goal: Turn prompts into gradable loops using outcomes, dynamic workflow patterns, routines, and worktree safety.
requiredPractices: Use fan-out-and-synthesize, adversarial verification, or loop-until-done intentionally.
Use worktrees for parallel edit safety when agents can collide.
Template long-running or recurring runs before scheduling them.

tiers.name: Self-improvement layer
tiers.goal: Close the loop by verifying outputs, writing state, distilling durable skill rules, and revalidating the loop.
requiredPractices: Record failures with enough evidence to reproduce.
Investigate and verify before calling a fact durable.
Distill reusable procedural lessons into the skill, not just chat.
Run the loop validator after loop artifact changes.

compoundStack.name: Primitives
compoundStack.purpose: Model roles, subagents, worktrees, and deterministic tools.

compoundStack.name: Orchestration
compoundStack.purpose: Outcome rubrics, dynamic workflows, routines, and objective stop conditions.

compoundStack.name: Memory
compoundStack.purpose: STATE.md and skill files that preserve verified facts and procedural rules.

compoundStack.name: Self-improvement
compoundStack.purpose: Independent verification, eval rubrics, vision checks where applicable, and rule distillation.

loopCloseout: Use an independent verifier for non-trivial work.
Write a run receipt with outcome, verifier report, validation output, and run metadata.
Update STATE.md before ending the run.
Distill durable procedural lessons into the skill.
Record the skill-update decision in run.json.
Report validation, gates not run, residual risks, and boundaries preserved.
